description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party], [Awoken Archive Master], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Archive Authority Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Archive Master
description.text: Black Magic and Summoning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Archive Authority Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed for Black Magic and Summoning abilities, casts Magical Surfing after using a Black Magic or Summoning ability, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Magical Surfing
description.text: One single attack (9.99/10.99) capped at 99999 if 1+ of Tyro, Elarra, Biggs or Wedge aren't/are alive
